claims.title: The literal signed path, exterior-column, and standard-index family
claims.statement: Signed horizontal-strip paths of dominant integer weights define Kcol by right exterior multiplication/contraction. Complementing nonpositive-column index subsets gives the source IsSt inequalities. The finite product equals Psi exactly, including all identity factors outside the effective range.

claims.title: Independence in every characteristic by canonical leading terms and generic flag minors
claims.statement: Canonical path products have a unit leading component recovering the preceding endpoint. Their fixed-endpoint independence holds over every field. Jacobi converts generic terminal-index coefficients into determinant powers times standard flag-minor products with distinct diagonal leading monomials. A maximal-endpoint projection combines the two independence statements. No rational isotypic membership is asserted.

claims.title: Pieri counting and the unimodular integral path basis
claims.statement: Row insertion proves the horizontal-strip counting identity; complement-reversal gives downward strips and determinant shifts allow arbitrary integer weights. Iteration matches the monomial count. All-prime independence forces the integer coefficient determinant to be a unit, giving the actual basis over every commutative ring.
claims.derivation: The all-prime determinant argument translates the source. The expanded report proves the count directly by semistandard row insertion; the archive's exported count uses Gelfand--Tsetlin recursion. The count is not an unresolved representation theorem.

claims.title: Simultaneous integral adaptation to every prefix minimum and maximum
claims.statement: Over an integral domain, the same integral basis is adapted to all source generic-conjugated rank-one prefix minimum/maximum bounds. The full-prefix converse isolates a maximal bad endpoint. Earlier prefixes follow from cutting the actual columns and counting continuations. Uniqueness intersects all prefix conditions, and fraction-field descent retains integral coefficients.
claims.derivation: This replaces the source's larger abstract representation-filtration route with an elementary generic-weight and dimension argument. It does not assert an integral direct sum of individual rational irreducibles. The exact coordinate-weight/generic-conjugate identification is explained in IP4 of report.txt.

claims.title: All column clauses of the shared PlaneGram SPAN interface
claims.statement: The exact Kcol factors are multilinear on their occurrence sets, each letter occurs in d_i factors, positive height is bounded by preceding vector occurrences, prefix column valuation is at least colVal, and summing colVal gives the last path coordinate. Together with IP3--IP4 these prove the literal PlaneGram.SPAN, over the valuation ring in that interface.

claims.title: The exact integral MGen0-to-PGen spanning inclusion
claims.statement: Apply the simultaneous integral path basis to A and G in each literal MGen0 generator. The source CondM zero-gap bounds give precisely the cross-block interlacing inequalities; the initial preceding-frame block has only vector letters and G-degree zero. Appending the two paths produces exactly PGen, so multiplying the integral expansions proves GeneratorSpanInclusion.

claims.title: Literal split-product identity and direct weighted normal homogeneity
claims.statement: For each actual PGen, prod_plTan gives P as the product of its joined split columns. A column's block changes once per used letter; the normal weighted degree is exactly the sum of p^(z-s_i) at costly steps. The source size bound N+r<=K keeps every negative column above the rank boundary. Parity is preserved by reduction modulo even n'.

claims.title: All-chart divisibility and the two-extra-powers margin
claims.statement: The moving exterior-basis identity V^[P]L_t=w^(aP)(Z^[P]+pR), P=p^(t-s), follows from entrywise Witt-Frobenius congruence. Since p=w^2, a nonnominal component gains two extra powers across a strict gap. Nominal support and costly-step geometry then give the exact predicted column order in every chart, including negative columns.

claims.title: Own-chart leading congruence with exact signs and uniform key bound
claims.statement: After division by the predicted w-power, only the prescribed split block survives modulo w. Strict gaps kill unwanted tangential terms at costly steps. The right-wedge signs equal those of plTanCol; the negative-column height bound is used here. Residue Frobenius produces phSeg, and distinct positions give a_c<2p^(z-s_0)<=2Q. This proves all IsKey clauses and the separate TT-support requirement.

claims.title: Products of the actual column keys prove GeneratorImageIsSymbol
claims.statement: Multiplying the literal leading keys gives w^o phSeg(P), with o the sum of their costly orders. Its normal degree is exactly o. The product belongs to bc_KP and hence bc_agen(o,0) with coefficient one, so it satisfies the exact Sy definition. Zero factors cause no exception.
